instruction: Candid full shot of two men sparring in an outdoor covered training area during the day. On the right, the man in the beige t-shirt (R1) lunges forward, throwing a straight right punch. On the left, the man in the blue tank top (R2) stands in a defensive stance, blocking the punch with his black boxing gloves raised to his head. Bright daylight illuminates the scene, casting natural shadows on the concrete floor.
elements: R1 lunges forward and throws a straight right punch toward R2
R2 is in the defensive role, blocking R1's punch rather than punching R1
R1 is the attacking puncher while R2 is the blocker
R2 raises black boxing gloves to his head to absorb or block the punch
The sparring occurs in an outdoor covered training area during daylight
Natural shadows fall on the concrete floor
